title: Head pressure building?
caption: Head pressure building? Today has a mild, bumpy feel in the air—ups and downs are likely for some, and screens or dry rooms can stack it. Take brief eye and neck breaks, add hydration with a pinch of electrolytes, and pace the bigger tasks.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity is on the active side and solar wind is elevated. Magnetic orientation is near neutral, which still allows ups and downs. There are no recent flares or CMEs. The low resonant background is close to typical.
affects: A mild unsettled backdrop can nudge head or sinus pressure for some people. Screens, dehydration, and indoor air can stack that effect. Sensitivity may show up as a dull, pressing feel rather than sharp pain.
playbook:
- Take brief eye and neck breaks
- Add hydration and a pinch of electrolytes
- Get a few minutes of fresh air
- Dim screens and increase font size
